cards.answer: Gragas is a fighter and mage with AP-scaling magic damage. He slows enemies with barrels, charges in to stun them, and uses his ultimate to knock them away.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from his charge and avoid clustering around his barrels.

cards.answer: Barrel Roll places a cask that Gragas can detonate after it arrives; it also explodes automatically when its duration ends. The explosion deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies, with greater damage and a stronger slow as the cask ferments.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the cask before it explodes; avoid lingering near a fermenting barrel.

cards.answer: Drunken Rage gives Gragas temporary damage reduction. After completing its channel, his next basic attack deals bonus magic damage to the target and nearby enemies, including damage based on each target's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance from his empowered attack and avoid committing damage while his damage reduction is active.

cards.answer: Body Slam charges forward and stops at the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back and stunning them. Hitting an enemy reduces its remaining cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep his charge and avoid standing close to allies in its path; respect a faster follow-up after it connects.
